user.title: ADB FullTV Setup
user.description: You can automatically discover your TV on the network or enter the IP address manually.

scan.title: Select Device
scan.description: Select a device. Pairing is enabled by default, but you can skip it and pair later.

pair.title: Pairing
pair.description: Enter the code shown on the TV screen. If no code appears, use the action field to resend the code or skip pairing.

error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Try again or skip pairing.
error.pair_start_failed: Could not resend pairing request. Make sure the TV is powered on and on the same network.

abort.local_ip_failed: Could not determine local IP address.

init.title: Options
